tools.name: sql_query_dim_equipment
tools.description: Run a parameterized read query against dim_equipment (equipment master synced from SAP PM, extended with run_hours_total, oem_service_interval_hours, last_service_date) using the read-only svc_ai_readonly account. Used by the Maintenance Scheduler skill to build due-list candidates.

tools.name: sql_query_technician_availability
tools.description: Run a parameterized read query against dim_technician_availability (staged from HR roster + Outlook Calendar free/busy sync) using the read-only svc_ai_readonly account. Used by the Resource Planner skill to filter candidate technicians by certification, shift, and available dates.

tools.name: sql_query_maintenance_history
tools.description: Run a parameterized read query against fact_maintenance_history (consolidated work order/notification history, extended with plan_id, planned_date, completed_date, status, variance_days) using the read-only svc_ai_readonly account. Used for soft-constraint learning and schedule-compliance KPI reporting.

tools.name: sql_write_ai_recommendation
tools.description: Insert a proposed schedule, resource assignment, or re-optimization diff into fact_ai_recommendations using the write-scoped svc_ai_writer account, tagged with model_version, agent_id, and generated_at. This is the only table (besides the audit log) any skill in this use case writes to; no skill has or requires write access to source-of-record tables.

tools.name: sql_write_audit_log
tools.description: Insert an audit record (actor, timestamp, payload hash, triggering event ID) for a schedule proposal, approval/rejection, override, or write-back, using the write-scoped svc_ai_writer account.
